nary_nodes.label: Samsung Q2 profit forecast
evidence: South Korean technology giant Samsung Electronics says it expects to post a 19-fold jump in its profits, driven by global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) memory chips.
The company forecast that it made 89.4tn won (£43.6bn; $58.4bn) between the start of April and the end of June, marking its third record quarterly operating profits in a row.

nary_nodes.label: Samsung Q2 sales forecast
evidence: Samsung said in the preview, known as earnings guidance, that it brought in around 171tn won of sales during the quarter, more than double the amount for the same period last year.

nary_nodes.label: Samsung chip price hike
evidence: Samsung has hiked the prices of its memory chips as supplies remain tight.

nary_nodes.label: Samsung shares fall
evidence: Samsung's shares fell by almost 7% in Seoul on Tuesday as some investors had expected its profits to have been even higher.

nary_nodes.label: Samsung stock value doubles
evidence: Its stock market value has more than doubled since the start of this year, while South Korean rival SK Hynix has jumped by more than 200%.
